items.text: Ore apa pee eidipayu esuntai naidipa nkikeneta oo nchomito, neidipaki aategelu ilarripok loo nchomito, o laranyak, o Lawi,
naisho nanu, olalashe lai Hanani o Hanania meitasheiki Yerusalem. Amu oltung'ani apa oisiligayu neure Enkai alang ilkumok.

Najoki nanu ninche, “Emincho ake nchomito e Yerusalem eboli ometaba anaa neilepu enkolong; naa ore eton eitashe aarripisho nchoo ninche eiken nepik isekenke ooikenieki nchomito. Entegelu ilarripok tiatua lelo oomanya Yerusalem, neitashe ake pooki ng'ae te rishata enye, neipirare ake oltung'ani enkaji enye.”
Esiana e lelo ootorrinyunye te yararoto
Aisapuk apa ina anasa nelala, kake ore iltung'ana ootii atua naa kuti nemetii nkajijik naaidipaki aateshet.
Nepik apa Enkai ndamunot aainei pee aiturrur ilkituaak, o larikok, o ltung'ana pee eiger pooki anaa ntipati oo lmareita, lelo apa ootangasa aapuonu, natum nanu eigeroki aaiko nji:
Iltung'ana lo lkerenket kulo apa ooetuo eing'uaa eyararoto e lelo apa ootarayie Nebukadnesa olaiguanani le Babilon nenap aya, etorrinyunye ninche Yerusalem o Yuda nelo ake pooki ng'ae enkang enye.
Eetuo apa ninche tenebo Serubabel, o Yoshua, o Nehemia, o Asaria, o Raamia o Nahamani, o Mordekai, o Bilshan o Misparet o Bigfai, o Nehum o Baana.
Ore esiana oo ltung'ana le Israel:
lelo ayiok le Perosh, naa nkalifuni are o iip nabo o ntomoni naapishana oare.
Ore ilayiok le Shefatia naa iip uni o ntomoni naapishana oare.
Ore ilayiok le Ara, naa iip ile o onomm oare.
Ore ilayiok le Pahatmoab, aa taa ilayiok le Yoshua o Yoab, naa nkalifuni are o iip isiet o tomon o isiet.
Ore ilayiok le Elam naa enkalifu nabo o iip are o onom o ong'uan.
Ore ilayiok le Setu naa iip isiet o artam o imiet.
Ore ilayiok le Sakai, naa iip naapishana o ntomoni ile.
Ore ilayiok le Binui, naa iip ile o artam o isiet.
Ore ilayiok le Bebai naa iip ile o tikitam o isiet.
Ore ilayiok le Asgad, naa nkalifuni are o iip uni o tikitam o are.
Ore ilayiok le Adonikan naa iip ile ontomoni ile oopishana.
Ore ilayiok le Bigfai naa nkalifuni are o ntomoni naapishana.
Ore ilayiok le Adin naa iip ile o onomm o imiet.
Ore ilayiok le Ater, a taa ile Hesekia naa ntomoni naaudo o isiet.
Ore ilayiok le Hashum naa iip uni o tikitam o isiet.
Ore ilayiok le Besai, naa iip uni o tikitam o ong'uan.
Ore ilayiok le Harif naa iip o tomon oare.
Ore ilayiok le Gibeon naa ntomoni naaudo o imiet.
Ore iltung'ana le Betlehem o Netofa naa iip ontomoni isiet o isiet.
Ore iltung'ana le Anatot naa iip o tikitam o isiet.
Ore iltung'ana le Bet-asmapet naa artam oare.
Ore iltung'ana le Kiriat-yearim, Kepira o Beerot, naa iip naapishana o artam o kuni.
Ore iltung'ana le Rama o Geb, naa iip ile o tikitam o obo.
Ore iltung'ana le Mikmas naa iip o tikitam o are.
Ore iltung'ana le Betel o Ai, naa iip o tikitam okuni.
Ore iltung'ana le nkae Nebo naa onomm o are.
Ore ilayiok le likae oji Elam naa enkalifu nabo o iip are o onomm o ong'uan.
Ore ilayiok le Harim, naa iip uni o tikitam.
Ore ilayiok le Yeriko naa iip uni o artam o imiet.
Ore ilayiok le Lod, Hadid o Ono, naa iip naapishana o tikitam o obo.
Ore ilayiok le Senaa naa nkalifuni naapishana o iip naaudo o tomoni uni.
Ore ilapolosak: lelo ayiok le Yedaia aa taa enkaji e Yoshua, naa iip naaudo o ntomoni naapishana o okuni.
Ore ilayiok le Imer, naa enkalifu nabo o onomm o are.
Ore ilayiok le Pashur, naa enkalifu nabo o iip are o artam o oopishana.
Ore ilayiok le Harim naa enkalifu nabo o tomon oopishana.
Ore Ilawi: lelo ayiok le Yoshua, aa taa ile Kadmiel loo layiok le Hedefa, naa ntomoni naapishana o ong'uan.
Ore ilaranyak lelo ayiok le Asaf, naa iip nabo o artam o isiet.
Ore ilarripok loo nchomito: lelo ayiok le Shalum, ilayiok le Ater, lelo ayiok le Talmon, lelo ayiok le Akub, lelo ayiok le Hatita, lelo ayiok le Shobai, naa iip nabo o tomoni uni o isiet.
Ore lelo aisiaayiak le nkaji e Nkai, lelo ayiok le Siha, lelo ayiok le Hasufa, lelo ayiok le Taabaot,
lelo ayiok le Keros, lelo ayiok le Sia, lelo ayiok le Padon
lelo ayiok le Lebana, lelo ayiok le Hagaba lelo ayiok le Shalmai,
lelo ayiok le Hanan, lelo ayiok le Gidel, lelo ayiok le Gahar,
lelo ayiok le Reia, lelo ayiok le Resin, lelo ayiok le Nekoda,
lelo ayiok le Gesam, lelo ayiok le Usa, lelo ayiok le Pasea,
lelo ayiok le Besai, lelo ayiok le Meunim, lelo ayiok le Nefushesim,
lelo ayiok le Bakbuk, lelo ayiok le Hakufa, lelo ayiok le Hashur,
lelo ayiok le Bashit, lelo ayiok le Mehida, lelo ayiok le Harsha,
lelo ayiok le Barkos lelo ayiok le Sisera, lelo ayiok le Tema,
lelo ayiok le Nesia, lelo ayiok le Hatifa.
Ore ilayiok loo sinkan le Solomon, ilayiok le Sotai, ilayiok le Soferet, ilayiok le Persida,
ilayiok le Yaala, ilayiok le Darkon, ilayiok le Gidel,
ilayiok le Shefatia, ilayiok le, Hatil, ilayiok le Pokeret-Lasebaim, lelo ayiok le Amon.
Ore isinkan pooki le nkaji e Nkai, o sinkan loo layiok le Solomon pooki naa iip uni o ntomoni naaudo oare.
Kulo oodukino apa lelo ooetuo eing'uaa Telmela, Telhasha, Keurub, Adon, o Imer, kake meidim apa ninche aaibalie ilmareita loo loo menye aashu ineeikino ninche, tenaa ke ltung'ana le Israel ninche.
Ilayiok le Delaia, ilayiok le Tobia, ilayiok le Nekoda, naa iip ile o artam oare.
Ore sii ilapolosak: lelo ayiok le Hobaia, lelo ayiok le Hakos, ilayiok le Barsilai, (laa ninye apa oyama entito nabo too ntoyie e Barsilai le Gilead neaku ninche eipotieki).
Eing'orutua kulo enkigeroto oo nkarn enye tenebo lelo ooigeroki too lmareita, kake eitu etumi teine, neaku etundung'oyioki too lapolosak aajo keiduruk;
Enkig 33.8
etiaaka olbalusui ninche pee mejing ninche enkinosata eina daa sinyati aisul, ometaba anaa nedumunye olapolosani oata Urim o Tummim.
Ore apa eumata pooki tenebo naa nkalifuni artam oare o iip uni o ntomoni ile
metii isinkan lenye lewa o sinkan enye ng'oruo, nera apa ninche nkalifuni naapishana o iip uni o ntomoni ile o opishana; neeta apa ninche ilaranyak iip are o artam o imiet, ilewa o ng'oruo.
Ore mbartan enye naa iip naapishana o tomoni uni o ile. Ore inyumpui enye naa iip are o artam o imiet.
Ore ntamesin enye naa iip ong'uan o tomoni uni o imiet. Ore isirkon lenye naa nkalifuni ile o iip naapishana o tikitam.

Ore apa ilukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye neishooyo nkishorot tenkaraki esiaai. Eishooyie olbalusui apik olchumati nkiloi isiet e sahabu, o ngirran onomm, o lkilani loo lapolosak iip imiet o tomoni uni.
Ore ilkulikae oora ilukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye neishooyo aapik olchumati le siaai sahabu nkiloi iip o ntomoni ile, o imiet, o enkosholai nkiloi enkalifu nabo o iip are o onomm.
Ore ilkulikae tung'ana neishooyo sahabu nkiloi iip nabo o ntomoni ile o isiet, o nkiloi iip nabo o artam e nkosholai, o lkilani ntomoni ile oopishana loo lapolosak.
1 Ilai 9.2
Neh 11.3
Neaku ore ilapolosak, lelo le Lawi, o larripok loo nchomito, o laranyak, o embata oo ltung'ana, o embata oo sinkan le nkaji e Nkai, o Siraeli pooki; netoni too nkang'itie enye.
Ore pee ebau olapa liopishana, netii nkera e Israel nkang'itie enye maate.
